Data extraction: PO gettext message pairs with msgid as key and msgstr as value

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.treesitterlanguagepack.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var configJson = "{\"data_extraction\":true,\"language\":\"po\"}";
        var config = JsonUtil.fromJson(configJson, ProcessConfig.class);
        var result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("msgid \"Hello\"\nmsgstr \"Hallo\"\n", config);
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
```
